highlights:
# Ambral

Ambral is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Ambral is a global fulfillment platform that protects and grows revenue across their merchant base. They use AI to protect and grow revenue across their merchant base. Ambral employs 4 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Ambral is building the AI stack for turning enterprise history into evals, environments, and company-specific intelligence.

Our systems are already deployed at multi-billion dollar enterprises across customer intelligence, account management, and other complex customer-facing workflows.

Under the hood, we reconstruct historical company state and turn real work into replayable environments and automatically generated evals grounded in real workflows and outcomes. We use those evals to measure, compare, and improve company-specific models through post-training, context engineering, and agent engineering, building AI that gets better at the work unique to each company.

We're backed by YCombinator and other top investors and hiring exceptional builders and researchers.

## Company Details
- Industry: Technology, Information and Internet
- Type: Privately held
- Headquarters: San Francisco, United States
- Founded Year: 2025
- Homepage: ambral.com
- Aliases: ambral
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/ambral
- Linkedin Followers: 1,110
- Emails: [email redacted]
